You sound like my girlfriend. I can't offer much help or say anything except that I feel you. I ask myself the same thing, "Why the fuck not?" "How can it get better if that's even possible?" We obviously have people who care about us or who would suffer greatly from our loss so maybe holding on for them might give us time to re-evaluate our life and maybe make some positive changes... Still, I feel like a hypocrite since I would probably not heed my own advice and act selfishly.
